verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־ אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr dā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- diḇ·rê haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ bə·yō·wm hiṣ·ṣîl Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw mik·kap̄ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇāw ū·mik·kap̄ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: And David sang . . . this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul
verses.literalPt: Davi falou a Jeová as palavras deste cântico no dia em que Jeová o livrou da mão de todos os seus inimigos e das mãos de Saul;

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣu·ḏā·ṯî ū·mə·p̄al·ṭî- lî
verses.literal: He said The LORD is my rock my fortress and my deliverer . . .
verses.literalPt: e disse: Jeová é o meu rochedo, a minha fortaleza e o meu libertador.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־ בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣū·rî ’e·ḥĕ·seh- bōw mā·ḡin·nî wə·qe·ren yiš·‘î miś·gab·bî ū·mə·nū·sî mō·ši·‘î mê·ḥā·mās tō·ši·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: My God is my rock in whom I take refuge . . . my shield and the horn of my salvation My stronghold my refuge and my Savior You save me from violence
verses.literalPt: É o Deus da minha rocha, nele confiarei; é o meu escudo, e a força da minha salvação, e a minha alta torre, e o meu refúgio; Ó meu salvador, da violência tu me livras.

verses.original: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·hul·lāl ’eq·rā Yah·weh ū·mê·’ō·yə·ḇay ’iw·wā·šê·a‘
verses.literal: I will call upon the LORD who is worthy to be praised so shall I be saved from my enemies
verses.literalPt: Hei de invocar a Jeová, que é digno de louvor; assim, serei salvo dos meus inimigos.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־ מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·p̄ā·p̄u·nî miš·bə·rê- mā·weṯ na·ḥă·lê ḇə·lî·ya·‘al yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯu·nî
verses.literal: For the waves of death engulfed me the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me
verses.literalPt: Porque me cercaram as ondas da morte, as torrentes da impiedade me atemorizaram.

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeḇ·lê šə·’ō·wl sab·bu·nî qid·də·mu·nî mō·qə·šê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: The cords of Sheol entangled me the snares of death confronted me
verses.literalPt: As cordas do Sheol me cingiram, os laços da morte me apanharam.

verses.original: בַּצַּר־ לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣar- lî ’eq·rā Yah·weh wə·’el- ’ĕ·lō·hay ’eq·rā way·yiš·ma‘ mê·hê·ḵā·lōw qō·w·lî wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî bə·’ā·zə·nāw
verses.literal: In my distress . . . I called upon the LORD I cried out to my God And from His temple He heard my voice and my cry for help reached His ears
verses.literalPt: Na minha angústia, invoquei a Jeová; sim, invoquei ao meu Deus. Do seu templo ouviu a minha voz, e o meu clamor chegou aos seus ouvidos.

verses.original: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־ חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·ʿaš wat·tir·‘aš hā·’ā·reṣ mō·ws·ḏō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim yir·gā·zū way·yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū kî- ḥā·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Then the earth shook and quaked the foundations of the heavens trembled they were shaken because He burned with anger
verses.literalPt: Então, a terra se comoveu e estremeceu, os fundamentos do céu se moveram e se abalaram, porque ele se irou.

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·šān bə·’ap·pōw wə·’êš mip·pîw tō·ḵêl ge·ḥā·lîm bā·‘ă·rū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Smoke rose from His nostrils and consuming fire came from His mouth glowing coals blazed forth
verses.literalPt: Das suas narinas subiu fumo, e da sua boca saiu fogo devorador, que pôs carvões em chamas.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ šā·ma·yim way·yê·raḏ wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet
verses.literalPt: Abaixou também os céus e desceu; e havia escuridade debaixo dos seus pés.

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־ כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·kaḇ ‘al- kə·rūḇ way·yā·‘ōp̄ way·yê·rā ‘al- kan·p̄ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: He mounted . . . a cherub and flew He soared on the wings of the wind
verses.literalPt: Montou num querubim e voou; e foi visto sobre as asas do vento.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־ מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeṯ ḥō·šeḵ sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯāw suk·kō·wṯ ḥaš·raṯ- ma·yim ‘ā·ḇê šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: He made darkness a canopy around Him a gathering of water and thick clouds
verses.literalPt: Fez das trevas tendas ao redor de si, ajuntamento de águas, espessas nuvens do céu.

verses.original: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: min·nō·ḡah neḡ·dōw bā·‘ă·rū ga·ḥă·lê- ’êš
verses.literal: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth
verses.literalPt: Pelo esplendor que estava diante dele acenderam-se carvões de fogo.

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־ שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yar·‘êm min- šā·ma·yim Yah·weh wə·‘el·yō·wn yit·tên qō·w·lōw
verses.literal: The LORD thundered from heaven the voice of the Most High resounded
verses.literalPt: Jeová trovejou do céu, e o Altíssimo fez soar a sua voz.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק וַיְהֻמֵּם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥiṣ·ṣîm way·p̄î·ṣêm bā·rāq way·hum·mēm
verses.literal: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes He hurled lightning and routed them
verses.literalPt: Disparou setas e dissipou-os; raios, e desbaratou-os.

verses.original: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā·’ū ’ă·p̄i·qê yām yig·gā·lū mō·sə·ḏō·wṯ tê·ḇêl bə·ḡa·‘ă·raṯ Yah·weh min·niš·maṯ rū·aḥ ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: The channels of the sea appeared and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD at the blast of the breath of His nostrils
verses.literalPt: Então, apareceram as profundezas do mar, descobriram-se os fundamentos do mundo, pela repreensão de Jeová, ao assopro do vento dos seus narizes.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ mim·mā·rō·wm yiq·qā·ḥê·nî yam·šê·nî mim·ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: He reached down from on high and took hold of me He drew me out of deep waters
verses.literalPt: Enviou do alto e recebeu-me; tirou-me das muitas águas;

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mê·’ō·yə·ḇî ‘āz miś·śō·nə·’ay kî ’ā·mə·ṣū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: He rescued me from my powerful enemy from foes too mighty for me
verses.literalPt: livrou-me do meu inimigo poderoso e dos que me tinham ódio, porque eram mais fortes do que eu.

verses.original: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qad·də·mu·nî bə·yō·wm ’ê·ḏî way·hî Yah·weh miš·‘ān lî
verses.literal: They confronted me in my day of calamity but the LORD was my support
verses.literalPt: Vieram sobre mim no dia da minha calamidade, porém Jeová se fez o meu esteio.

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־ חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣê lam·mer·ḥāḇ ’ō·ṯî yə·ḥal·lə·ṣê·nî kî- ḥā·p̄êṣ bî
verses.literal: He brought me out into the open He rescued me because He delighted in me
verses.literalPt: Conduziu-me para um lugar espaçoso; livrou-me, porque se agradou de mim.

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·mə·lê·nî Yah·weh kə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî kə·ḇōr yā·ḏay yā·šîḇ lî
verses.literal: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands
verses.literalPt: Jeová recompensou-me segundo a minha justiça, retribuiu-me segundo a pureza das minhas mãos.

verses.original: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî šā·mar·tî dar·ḵê Yah·weh wə·lō rā·ša‘·tî mê·’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God
verses.literalPt: Pois guardei os caminhos de Jeová e não obrei impiamente, apartando-me do meu Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָל־ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־ אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl miš·på̄·ṭō lə·neḡ·dî wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw lō- ’ā·sūr mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: For all His ordinances are before me I have not disregarded . . . His statutes
verses.literalPt: Porque todos os seus juízos estavam diante de mim; e, quanto aos seus estatutos, deles não me arredei.

verses.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eh·yeh ṯā·mîm lōw wā·’eš·tam·mə·rāh mê·‘ă·wō·nî
verses.literal: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity
verses.literalPt: Fui também perfeito para com ele e guardei-me da minha iniquidade.

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ Yah·weh lî kə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî kə·ḇō·rî lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness according to my cleanness in His sight
verses.literalPt: Por isso, me retribuiu Jeová segundo a minha justiça, segundo a minha pureza diante dos seus olhos.

verses.original: עִם־ חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־ גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- ḥā·sîḏ tiṯ·ḥas·sāḏ ‘im- gib·bō·wr tā·mîm tit·tam·mām
verses.literal: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful to the blameless . . . You show Yourself blameless
verses.literalPt: Para com o misericordioso, mostrar-te-ás misericordioso, para com o homem perfeito, mostrar-te-ás perfeito,

verses.original: עִם־ נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- nā·ḇār tit·tā·ḇār wə·‘im- ‘iq·qêš tit·tap·pāl
verses.literal: to the pure You show Yourself pure but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd
verses.literalPt: para com o puro, mostrar-te-ás puro e para com o pervertido, mostrar-te-ás tortuoso.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־ רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘am ‘ā·nî tō·wō·šî·a‘ wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘al- rā·mîm taš·pîl
verses.literal: You save an afflicted people but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down
verses.literalPt: Livrarás o povo humilhado, mas os teus olhos estão sobre os altivos, para que os abatas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh nê·rî Yah·weh Yah·weh yag·gî·ah ḥā·šə·kî
verses.literal: For You O LORD are my lamp the LORD lights up my darkness
verses.literalPt: Pois tu és, Jeová, a minha candeia; e Jeová alumiará as minhas trevas.

verses.original: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·ḵāh ’ā·rūṣ gə·ḏūḏ bê·lō·hay ’ă·ḏal·leḡ- šūr
verses.literal: For in You I can charge an army with my God I can scale a wall
verses.literalPt: Pois, com o teu auxílio, posso atacar uma tropa; e, com o auxílio do meu Deus, posso saltar um muro.

verses.original: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl tā·mîm dar·kōw ’im·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·rū·p̄āh mā·ḡên hū lə·ḵōl ha·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: As for God His way is perfect the word of the LORD is flawless He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Deus, o seu caminho é perfeito; a palavra de Jeová é purificada; ele é o escudo de todos os que nele confiam.

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִי־ אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî- ’êl mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ū·mî ṣūr mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: For who is God besides the LORD And who is the Rock except our God
verses.literalPt: Pois quem é Deus, senão Jeová? E quem é rocha, senão o nosso Deus?

verses.original: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דַּרְכּוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl mā·‘ūz·zî ḥā·yil way·yat·têr tā·mîm dar·kō
verses.literal: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear
verses.literalPt: Deus é o meu refúgio poderoso e faz o meu caminho perfeito.

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רַגְלָיו כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šaw·weh raḡ·lå̄w kā·’ay·yā·lō·wṯ wə·‘al bā·mō·w·ṯay ya·‘ă·mi·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights
verses.literalPt: Ele iguala os meus pés com os das gazelas e me põe sobre as minhas alturas.

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־ נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·lam·mêḏ yā·ḏay lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·ni·ḥaṯ qe·šeṯ- nə·ḥū·šāh zə·rō·‘ō·ṯāy
verses.literal: He trains my hands for battle my arms can bend a bow of bronze
verses.literalPt: Ele instrui as minhas mãos para a peleja, de modo que os meus braços podem entesar um arco de cobre.

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·ten- lî mā·ḡên yiš·‘e·ḵā wa·‘ă·nō·ṯə·ḵā tar·bê·nî
verses.literal: You have given me Your shield of salvation and Your gentleness exalts me
verses.literalPt: Também me deste o escudo da tua salvação, e a tua condescendência me engrandeceu.

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tar·ḥîḇ ṣa·‘ă·ḏî taḥ·tê·nî wə·lō mā·‘ă·ḏū qar·sul·lāy
verses.literal: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way
verses.literalPt: Alargaste os meus passos debaixo de mim, e não vacilaram os meus artelhos.

verses.original: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־ כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’er·də·p̄āh ’ō·yə·ḇay wā·’aš·mî·ḏêm wə·lō ’ā·šūḇ ‘aḏ- kal·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them I did not turn back until they were consumed
verses.literalPt: Persegui os meus inimigos, e os derrotei, e não tornei atrás, até os consumir.

verses.original: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḵal·lêm wā·’em·ḥā·ṣêm wə·lō yə·qū·mūn way·yip·pə·lū ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise they have fallen under my feet
verses.literalPt: Consumi-os e os atravessei, de sorte que não se pudessem levantar. Sim, caíram debaixo dos meus pés.

verses.original: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·taz·rê·nî ḥa·yil lam·mil·ḥā·māh taḵ·rî·a‘ qā·may taḥ·tê·nî
verses.literal: You have armed me with strength for battle You have subdued my foes beneath me
verses.literalPt: Pois me cingiste de força para a peleja; fizeste curvar-se debaixo de mim os que se levantaram contra mim.

verses.original: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·yə·ḇay tat·tāh lî ‘ō·rep̄ mə·śan·’ay wā·’aṣ·mî·ṯêm
verses.literal: You have made my enemies retreat before me I destroyed those who hated me
verses.literalPt: Fizeste que me voltassem as costas os meus inimigos, para que eu exterminasse os que me aborrecem.

verses.original: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·‘ū wə·’ên mō·šî·a‘ ’el- Yah·weh wə·lō ‘ā·nām
verses.literal: They looked but there was no one to save them to the LORD but He did not answer
verses.literalPt: Olharam ao redor, porém não houve ninguém que os salvasse; olharam para Jeová, mas ele não lhes respondeu.

verses.original: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־ אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־ חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eš·ḥā·qêm ka·‘ă·p̄ar- ’ā·reṣ kə·ṭîṭ- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·ḏiq·qêm ’er·qā·‘êm
verses.literal: I ground them as the dust of the earth I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets
verses.literalPt: Então, os moí como o pó da terra; como a lama das ruas os pisei e os dissipei.

verses.original: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî mê·rî·ḇê ‘am·mî tiš·mə·rê·nî lə·rōš gō·w·yim ‘am lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: You have delivered me from the strife of my people You have preserved me as the head of nations a people I had not known shall serve me
verses.literalPt: Também me livraste das contendas do meu povo; guardaste-me para ser o cabeça das nações. Um povo que não conheço me servirá.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־ לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê nê·ḵār yiṯ·ka·ḥă·šū- lî liš·mō·w·a‘ ’ō·zen yiš·šā·mə·‘ū lî
verses.literal: Foreigners . . . cower before me when they hear me . . . they obey me
verses.literalPt: Os estrangeiros submeter-se-ão a mim; logo que me conhecerem, obedecer-me-ão.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê nê·ḵār yib·bō·lū wə·yaḥ·gə·rū mim·mis·gə·rō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Foreigners . . . lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds
verses.literalPt: Os estrangeiros dissipar-se-ão e, tremendo, sairão dos seus lugares fortes.

verses.original: חַי־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- Yah·weh ū·ḇā·rūḵ ṣū·rî wə·yā·rum ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣūr yiš·‘î
verses.literal: The LORD lives and blessed be my Rock And may God the Rock of my salvation be exalted
verses.literalPt: Jeová vive, e bendita seja a minha rocha! E exaltado seja o Deus da rocha da minha salvação!

verses.original: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl han·nō·ṯên nə·qā·mōṯ lî ū·mō·w·rîḏ ‘am·mîm taḥ·tê·nî
verses.literal: the God who avenges . . . me and brings down nations beneath me
verses.literalPt: O Deus que me dá vingança, que sujeita povos debaixo de mim

verses.original: וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·ṣî·’î mê·’ō·yə·ḇāy ū·miq·qā·may tə·rō·wm·mê·nî mê·’îš ḥă·mā·sîm taṣ·ṣî·lê·nî
verses.literal: who frees me from my enemies You exalt me above my foes You rescue me from violent men
verses.literalPt: e que me tira dentre os meus inimigos. Tu me exaltas acima dos que se levantam contra mim; tu me livras do homem violento.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ō·wḏ·ḵā Yah·weh bag·gō·w·yim ū·lə·šim·ḵā ’ă·zam·mêr
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will praise You O LORD among the nations I will sing praises to Your name
verses.literalPt: Por isso, Jeová, te darei graças entre as nações e entoarei louvores ao teu nome.

verses.original: מַגְדִּיל יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־ חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: maḡ·dīl yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ mal·kōw wə·‘ō·śeh- ḥe·seḏ lim·šî·ḥōw lə·ḏā·wiḏ ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Great salvation He brings to His king He shows loving devotion to His anointed to David and his descendants forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele dá grande salvamento ao seu rei e faz misericórdia ao seu ungido, a Davi e à sua semente, para sempre.
